title: The Grammar That Is Not There
label: ch:zh-no-endings
canDo: I can state the four things Mandarin does not do — no verb endings, no agreement, no article, no separate nationality word — and name where somebody is from.

payoff.summary: Four facts about Mandarin's shape and one join, and the whole chapter adds not a single character: three of the four are things a reader must stop doing, and the fourth puts 中国 and 人 together for the first time.
